summary: Improved early bedtime suggestions to also account for recent sleep debt, naps and recovery sleep

sections.title: Improvements for todayOS+
items: Improved timing and duration for sunlight reminders. They now avoid unsuitable times and weather, and extend the daylight goal when sunlight is weaker
Improved place name formatting to avoid overly long location names

sections.title: Free updates
items: The home screen background now matches real-world sky colours more accurately, especially around sunrise and sunset, with improved support for high-latitude locations.

Added optional travel detection to reduce ‘Stand Up’ reminders while travelling in a vehicle. It requires Background Location and uses significant location changes instead of continuous location tracking.
